findings.summary: DirectExact traversal requires a loaded-project target and rejects generated-source expansion with a deterministic source-unavailable boundary.
Typed null is carried additively and rendered as bare null, distinct from the string literal null.
Argument summaries require unique contiguous ordinals beginning at zero.
Conservative credential suppression is covered end to end.

A compiler-backed Roslyn fixture proves true parameter ordinals, optional gaps, typed null, escaped strings, and credential literals through extraction; downstream focused tests prove presentation suppression.

focusedCommand.summary: 41 focused Analysis, Behavior, Scenario, and Wording tests passed after resolving all CT-9 review findings.

finalGate.summary: 181 Analysis, 63 Behavior, 149 Scenario, 105 Wording, and 25 locally available Acceptance tests passed. Four external-corpus tests were unavailable because their repositories are not installed; fresh CreditTransfer regeneration passed as the external lane.

notes: CT-9 retains the delegated mismatch diagnosis and traversal implementation but does not accept its original documentation or safety claims without verification.
The original candidate remains local and unchanged; only the final hardened tree will be prepared for publication.

Orchestrator inspection confirmed true Roslyn parameter ordinals are carried into all-or-nothing Method Flow summaries, incompatible body fingerprints are no longer compared, and no-flow/ambiguous-flow diagnostics are distinct.

Fresh CreditTransfer regeneration produced eight diagrams with 63 messages, zero logging messages/participants, zero generic control placeholders, and zero SC-DIRECT-MISMATCH or cross-project boundaries. Exact custom logger filtering recorded deterministic audit fallbacks.
